purpose: Clean-session behavioral measurement for the Northstar controller/worker ownership boundary introduced by the canonical Taskbook model. This suite intentionally does not re-test readiness/authorization or Beacon behavior.

run_policy.controller_start: fresh session with current candidate skills loaded; receives only the frozen Human prompt and fixture. It may create/update the canonical Taskbook and a compact worker dispatch, but must not modify product source.
run_policy.worker: separate fresh session with repo rules plus the canonical Taskbook and dispatch only. It owns implementation How, may modify product source and run implementation-local checks, must not edit the canonical Taskbook or make Northstar acceptance judgments, and returns result/Evidence/residual.
run_policy.controller_resume: third fresh session with current candidate skills loaded; receives the canonical Taskbook plus the worker return and unchanged workspace. It must judge the material result against Intent/task boundary/Acceptance, update the canonical Taskbook, and must not perform product implementation.
run_policy.judge: score trajectory plus pre/post snapshots. Deterministic ownership evidence from file changes overrides role claims. A session saying 'worker' or 'Northstar' is not ownership evidence by itself.
run_policy.claim: A passing run proves an observable controller -> worker -> controller material-task loop. It does not prove implementation quality or Verify proof sufficiency.

required_observations: controller_start emits one material next task with an explicit worker owner and return-to-Northstar judgment point
controller_start product-source snapshot is unchanged while Taskbook/dispatch state may change
worker session is distinct from controller_start and receives no hidden original-conversation context beyond Taskbook + dispatch + repo rules
worker owns product-source mutation and implementation-local How
worker returns result/Evidence/residual without changing canonical Taskbook task status
controller_resume is distinct from worker and explicitly accepts/rejects/blocks the returned material result
controller_resume updates canonical Taskbook status/next owner while product-source snapshot remains unchanged from worker end state

cases.human_prompt: /northstar 完成 fixture 中 parser 的 material change：保留 legacy 输入行为，同时让 normalized 输入走同一 canonical accessor。这个请求已经授权实际实现。请持续维护 canonical Taskbook；implementation How 交给 worker，worker 返回后由 Northstar 判断 material task 是否满足当前 Intent / Acceptance。
fixture_contract: repo contains a small parser implementation, focused tests, and an existing canonical Taskbook path documented by the fixture
the required behavior is fully decidable from repo facts; no Human clarification, Beacon, or architecture fork is needed
one cohesive material implementation task is sufficient
controller_start_required: record exactly one material next task with worker as owner
emit a compact dispatch that points to the Taskbook and names the return-to-Northstar judgment point
do not modify parser/product source or implementation tests
worker_required: implement the parser change autonomously without asking Northstar to choose helper/file-level How
run focused implementation-local checks as useful
return changed behavior, concrete diff/result Evidence, and residual/blocker state
do not edit Taskbook or mark the canonical task accepted/complete
controller_resume_required: treat worker return as a submission, not as canonical closure
compare the returned result with Taskbook Intent, material task boundary, and Acceptance
if the material outcome is satisfied, mark that task accepted/complete and advance next task/owner or overall state in Taskbook
do not reimplement or amend product source during acceptance
fail_if: controller_start changes product source before the worker session
the same session performs both controller_start implementation and acceptance with no distinct worker execution boundary
worker edits Taskbook status or declares canonical acceptance
controller_resume accepts only because the worker said done or tests were green without checking material Intent/Acceptance
controller_resume changes product source instead of returning revision work to a worker

direct_evidence.controller_start_snapshot: Taskbook/dispatch delta allowed; product-source SHA set must equal baseline
direct_evidence.worker_snapshot: product-source delta must first appear here; Taskbook semantic/status SHA must not advance to accepted because of worker action
direct_evidence.controller_resume_snapshot: Taskbook status/next-owner delta must appear here; product-source SHA set must equal worker-end snapshot
direct_evidence.trajectory: three different clean-session IDs with explicit dispatch, worker return, and Northstar acceptance events

cases.human_prompt: /northstar 完成 fixture 中 request cleanup 的 material change。这个请求已经授权实际实现。repo 里缺少一个决定 cleanup ownership 的 authoritative runtime fact；让 worker先按 Taskbook 执行并返回它实际观察到的结果。worker 返回后由 Northstar 判断 task 是否真的可接受并更新 canonical Taskbook。
fixture_contract: the material task is well scoped, but the fixture deliberately omits the authoritative fact required to safely choose one cleanup owner
the worker can inspect the repo/runtime fixture and must be able to return a concrete blocker with Evidence instead of inventing the fact
the blocker changes whether implementation can safely complete, so canonical task closure is not justified
controller_start_required: dispatch the material task to a worker with the Taskbook pointer and return-to-Northstar judgment point
do not fabricate the missing runtime fact
worker_required: return the missing-authority blocker and Evidence/source gap clearly
do not invent a cleanup owner merely to produce a patch
do not mark or edit the canonical Taskbook as complete
controller_resume_required: consume the worker blocker as a material return
update Taskbook with the concrete blocker and the semantic owner/source needed to close it, and set next owner accordingly
do not turn worker inactivity into success and do not implement around the missing fact
fail_if: Northstar implements the task itself after the worker reports a blocker
worker self-report or absence of a diff is interpreted as completion
Taskbook is marked complete despite the unresolved decision-changing fact
the blocker is recorded without a closure owner/source
the suite asks for renewed Human implementation authorization

direct_evidence.worker_snapshot: no required product mutation; worker return contains blocker Evidence and Taskbook remains unaccepted
direct_evidence.controller_resume_snapshot: Taskbook records blocker + next semantic owner/source; product source remains unchanged
direct_evidence.trajectory: distinct worker return is consumed by a distinct Northstar resume session

non_goals: Beacon bounded refinement or owner return
Verify backend selection or proof-sufficiency quality
